self_contained_context.background: Initiative determines who attacks first for entire combat. Calculated once at combat start as agility + D6 roll. Higher total wins. Attacker strikes first every round (attacker advantage rule).

business_rules.initiative_calculation: Initiative = Character.agility + D6 roll. Higher total becomes attacker.
business_rules.tie_breaker_rules: If totals equal: (1) higher base agility wins, (2) if still tied, first character wins
business_rules.attacker_role_persistence: Attacker/defender roles determined ONCE by initiative, persist through entire combat

e2e_scenarios_enabled.name: Character with higher agility wins initiative
Initiative tie resolved by first character rule

task_specification.motivation: Initiative sets combat order for entire fight. Demonstrates domain service with dependency injection and business rule enforcement (tie-breaker logic).
detailed_instructions: Fields: attacker, defender (Characters), attacker_roll, defender_roll, attacker_total, defender_total
Roll D6 for each character, calculate totals (agility + roll)
Determine winner with tie-breaker: higher total → higher agility → char1
Test: higher initiative wins, tie-breaker by agility, tie-breaker by first character
